tools.name: search_answers
tools.description: Search the answers Mike Fluff Press publishes (questions about crypto history, Bitcoin, stablecoins, fraud, AI agents, software after AI: "what happened to FTX", "who is Satoshi", "what is MCP") and the interactive experiments from the books. Use this first whenever the user asks a factual question

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Fetch one published answer by its id (from search_answers): the full direct answer, the explanatory sections, the FAQ, the chapters and experiments it cites and related answers, all with canonical URLs. Use after search_answers when the lead answer is not enough. Read-only.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List the books by Mike Fluff Press with title, subtitle, synopsis, status, canonical book page URL and the table of contents (which chapters are free to read). Use it to answer "what has Mike Fluff written" or before get_chapter_preview. Read-only.

tools.name: get_chapter_preview
tools.description: Return the text of one chapter. Free chapters come back in full. tools.name: get_booking_slots
tools.description: List the open 30-minute slots for a free video call with Mike Fluff (business diagnosis, AI automation, compliance, Architect Mode), as ISO 8601 UTC start times. Use before book_call; pass one of these exact values as its "slot". Read-only.

findings.detail: Description of "buy_book" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, list_books, run_diagnostic · Private data: get_chapter_preview, book_call, buy_course, buy_book, buy_chapter · Public sink: book_call, buy_course · Destructive: run_diagnostic, check_text.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_answers, get_answer, list_books, run_diagnostic · Private data: get_chapter_preview, book_call, buy_course, buy_book, buy_chapter · Public sink: book_call, buy_course · Destructive: run_diagnostic, check_text

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
